name: Demo — Operation Wocao
description: Demo scenario inspired by publicly documented Operation Wocao espionage activity. It condenses and enriches reported tradecraft into logical layers for visualization and is not an authoritative incident reconstruction.

layers.name: Adversary Infrastructure
layers.description: Research privileged targets, acquire servers and email accounts, and prepare public tooling for multi-hop operations.

layers.name: External Services
layers.description: Exploit public-facing JBoss servers or use stolen VPN access, then maintain web-based or proxied access.

layers.name: Privileged Endpoint
layers.description: Execute multiple scripting languages, capture credentials and MFA material, inject into processes, and evade host controls.

layers.name: Enterprise Network
layers.description: Discover accounts, services, shares, and storage; move tools laterally; automate collection; and remove operational traces.
